name: Camp Starfish
description_short: An overnight camp in Rindge, NH for children with emotional, behavioral and learning challenges. Its core programs have one staff member for every camper, and campers live in cabins on Lake Monomonac.
special_needs_notes: Serves children with emotional, behavioral and learning challenges. Core programs keep one staff member for every camper, but no child is assigned a single dedicated adult. A nurse lives on site; there is no doctor on site. Campers should feed themselves, use the toilet on their own, and be able to get around hilly ground. Not suitable for children with feeding tubes, IV medications or daily injections, or with frequent violent behavior. Accessibility is still being improved, so families of campers with mobility limits should call before applying. Vegetarian meals are available; gluten-free is partly available; kosher is not.
swim_waterfront_notes: More than 1/2 mile of shoreline on Lake Monomonac, with access from several private beaches.

Year-round office is at 873 Main St. Suite 1, Ashby, MA 01431, 978-637-2617; the address recorded is the summer camp site.
